master_core.sku.name: sku
master_core.sku.comment: Master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the F&B portfolio — the single source of truth for finished-good identity. Captures SKU code, GTIN/UPC/EAN barcodes, brand, sub-brand, product line, flavor/variety, pack size, net weight/volume, unit of measure, form factor (RTD, RTE, concentrate, powder, frozen), ABV where applicable, Brix target, pH range, product status (active, discontinued, on-hold, seasonal), launch date, discontinuation date, PLM stage, and product hierarchy classification. Anchor entity for the entire product domain and primary join key for all downstream domains (sales, supply, manufacturing, quality).

columns.name: sku_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the Stock Keeping Unit. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

columns.name: brand_id
columns.comment: Reference to the brand under which this SKU is marketed and sold.

columns.name: company_code_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Legal entity assignment per SKU needed for inter‑company profit/loss consolidation and tax reporting.

columns.name: cost_plus_model_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_plus_model. Business justification: Cost‑Plus Pricing Model linkage needed to apply a markup model to individual SKUs for margin planning.

columns.name: esg_disclosure_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_disclosure. Business justification: Links a SKU to its ESG disclosure record for regulatory reporting (e.g., EU CSRD, GRI).

columns.name: gl_account_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue GL account mapping required for sales posting per SKU; essential for financial reporting of product sales.

columns.name: hierarchy_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: Each SKU belongs to a node in the product hierarchy, enabling classification and reporting. Adding product_hierarchy_id FK eliminates redundant category fields.

columns.name: initiative_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_initiative. Business justification: Tracks which ESG initiative a SKU participates in; used in annual sustainability performance dashboards.

columns.name: packaging_profile_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to sustainability.packaging_profile. Business justification: Required for SKU‑level packaging sustainability reporting; product packaging spec references a packaging profile for carbon/waste metrics.

columns.name: price_list_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Required for Price List Assignment process where each SKU is linked to a governing price list for channel pricing governance.

columns.name: price_zone_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Geographic Price Zone assignment ties each SKU to a zone for region‑specific pricing rules.

columns.name: supplier_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Required for SKU‑level supplier assignment used in sourcing decisions, cost modeling, and supplier scorecard reporting.

columns.name: procedure_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_procedure. Business justification: Pricing Procedure Assignment in SAP: each SKU follows a specific pricing procedure for calculation rules.

columns.name: employee_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Product Owner assignment in SKU lifecycle governance report.

columns.name: product_registration_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_registration. Business justification: Required for regulatory product registration tracking; each SKU must be linked to its product registration record for label compliance and market approval.

columns.name: abv
columns.comment: Alcohol by volume percentage for alcoholic beverage products. Null for non-alcoholic products.

columns.name: allergen_matrix
columns.comment: Comprehensive list of major food allergens present in or potentially cross-contaminating the product (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame).

columns.name: brix_target
columns.comment: Target Brix measurement representing sugar content percentage for beverages and fruit products. Used for quality control and formulation.

columns.name: calories_per_serving
columns.comment: Total caloric content per serving as declared on the nutritional panel.

columns.name: clean_label_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product meets clean label criteria with minimal, recognizable ingredients and no artificial additives.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system.

columns.name: discontinuation_date
columns.comment: Date when the SKU was or will be discontinued and removed from active production and distribution.

columns.name: ean
columns.comment: 13-digit European Article Number barcode identifier used internationally for retail product identification.. Valid values are `^[0-9]{13}$`

columns.name: flavor_variety
columns.comment: Specific flavor, variety, or variant of the product (e.g., Original, Chocolate, Strawberry, Spicy, Mild).

columns.name: form_factor
columns.comment: Physical form and preparation state of the product (Ready to Eat, Ready to Drink, Concentrate, Powder, Frozen, Refrigerated, Shelf Stable, Fresh). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ready to eat|ready to drink|concentrate|powder|frozen|refrigerated|shelf stable|fresh — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: gluten_free_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product meets gluten-free labeling requirements (less than 20 ppm gluten).

columns.name: gtin
columns.comment: Global Trade Item Number used for international product identification. Can be GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14.. Valid values are `^[0-9]{8}|[0-9]{12}|[0-9]{13}|[0-9]{14}$`

columns.name: halal_certified_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product is certified halal by a recognized halal certification body.

columns.name: kosher_certified_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency.

columns.name: launch_date
columns.comment: Date when the SKU was first introduced to market and made available for sale.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the SKU master record was last modified or updated.

columns.name: net_volume
columns.comment: Net volume of the product contents for liquid or pourable products.

columns.name: net_weight
columns.comment: Net weight of the product contents excluding packaging.

columns.name: non_gmo_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product is verified as non-genetically modified organism (Non-GMO Project Verified or equivalent).

columns.name: organic_certified_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product is certified organic by USDA or equivalent organic certification body.

columns.name: pack_size
columns.comment: Consumer-facing pack size description (e.g., Single Serve, Family Pack, 6-Pack, 12-Pack, Case).

columns.name: packaging_type
columns.comment: Primary packaging format and material (e.g., Bottle, Can, Pouch, Box, Bag, Jar, Tray, Carton).

columns.name: ph_max
columns.comment: Maximum acceptable pH level (acidity measure) for the product. Critical for food safety and quality control.

columns.name: ph_min
columns.comment: Minimum acceptable pH level (acidity measure) for the product. Critical for food safety and quality control.

columns.name: plm_stage
columns.comment: Current stage in the Product Lifecycle Management process (Concept, Development, Validation, Commercialization, Growth, Maturity, Decline). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|validation|commercialization|growth|maturity|decline — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: product_description
columns.comment: Detailed description of the product including key features, ingredients, and usage occasions.

columns.name: product_line
columns.comment: Product line or sub-brand classification within the brand portfolio (e.g., Premium, Organic, Kids, Family Size).

columns.name: product_name
columns.comment: Full marketing name of the finished good product as it appears on packaging and in consumer-facing materials.

columns.name: product_status
columns.comment: Current lifecycle status of the SKU (Active, Discontinued, On Hold, Seasonal, Pending Launch, Phase Out).. Valid values are `active|discontinued|on hold|seasonal|pending launch|phase out`

columns.name: recyclable_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the primary packaging is recyclable through standard municipal recycling programs.

columns.name: serving_size
columns.comment: Standard serving size as declared on the nutritional panel with unit of measure (e.g., 1 cup (240ml), 28g, 1 bottle).

columns.name: servings_per_container
columns.comment: Number of servings contained in the package as declared on the nutritional panel.

columns.name: shelf_life_days
columns.comment: Number of days the product maintains quality and safety from production date under proper storage conditions.

columns.name: sku_code
columns.comment: Business identifier code for the SKU used across systems and operations. Alphanumeric code typically 6-20 characters.. Valid values are `^[A-Z0-9]{6,20}$`

columns.name: storage_temperature_max
columns.comment: Maximum storage temperature in Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety.

columns.name: storage_temperature_min
columns.comment: Minimum storage temperature in Celsius required to maintain product quality and safety.

columns.name: unit_of_measure
columns.comment: Standard unit of measure for net weight or volume (grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds, milliliters, liters, fluid ounces, gallons, each, count). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g|kg|mg|oz|lb|ml|l|fl oz|gal|ea|count — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: upc
columns.comment: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier used primarily in North America for retail scanning.. Valid values are `^[0-9]{12}$`

columns.name: vegan_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products.

columns.name: vegetarian_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the product is suitable for vegetarian diets (no meat, poultry, fish, or slaughter by-products).

master_core.category.name: category
master_core.category.comment: Master reference table for category. Referenced by category_id.

columns.name: category_id
columns.comment: Primary key for category

columns.name: parent_category_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the immediate parent category for hierarchical organization.

columns.name: allergen_info
columns.comment: Allergen statements applicable to the category (e.g., contains nuts, gluten‑free).

columns.name: category_code
columns.comment: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the category in external systems.

columns.name: category_name
columns.comment: Human‑readable name of the product category.

columns.name: category_type
columns.comment: High‑level classification of the category (e.g., Food, Beverage).

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the category record was first created in the system.

columns.name: category_description
columns.comment: Detailed textual description of the category.

columns.name: effective_from
columns.comment: Date when the category becomes valid for use.

columns.name: effective_until
columns.comment: Date when the category is retired or no longer valid (null if indefinite).

columns.name: hierarchy_level
columns.comment: Depth of the category within the category tree (root = 0).

columns.name: is_perishable
columns.comment: Indicates whether items in this category are perishable (true) or non‑perishable (false).

columns.name: marketing_description
columns.comment: Consumer‑facing description used in marketing materials.

columns.name: nutritional_profile
columns.comment: Standard nutritional characteristics for the category (e.g., high protein, low sugar).

columns.name: packaging_type
columns.comment: Standard packaging format for items in this category.

columns.name: regulatory_classification
columns.comment: Regulatory classification governing the category (e.g., GRAS, FDA approved).

columns.name: shelf_life_days
columns.comment: Typical shelf life of products within this category, expressed in days.

columns.name: category_status
columns.comment: Current lifecycle status of the category.

columns.name: target_market
columns.comment: Primary geographic market(s) where the category is sold.

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the most recent update to the category record.

master_core.product_standard_cost.name: product_standard_cost
master_core.product_standard_cost.comment: Standard cost record for each SKU capturing the fully-loaded COGS build-up: raw material cost, packaging cost, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, co-pack/toll manufacturing fee, freight-in, and total standard cost per case and per unit. Tracks cost version (current standard, prior year, budget, forecast), effective date, plant/production site, currency, and variance to prior period. Owned by product domain as the authoritative product-level cost attribute; feeds pricing strategy (RSP, EDLP), trade promotion ROI, and financial reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA CO module.

columns.name: product_standard_cost_id
columns.comment: Primary key for standard_cost

columns.name: employee_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Records employee approving standard cost, essential for cost control and finance reporting.

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.comment: Foreign key reference to the cost center responsible for this product cost. Links to the organizational unit that owns the cost build-up and variance accountability.

columns.name: plant_id
columns.comment: Foreign key reference to the manufacturing plant or production site where this cost applies. Standard costs can vary by production location due to regional labor rates, overhead allocation, and sourcing differences.

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.comment: Foreign key reference to the profit center for internal profitability reporting. Enables brand-level or category-level margin analysis and Return on Investment (ROI) tracking.

columns.name: sku_id
columns.comment: Foreign key reference to the SKU master data. Links this cost record to the specific finished good product.

columns.name: approval_date
columns.comment: The date on which this standard cost was formally approved for use in financial reporting and pricing decisions. Part of the cost governance audit trail.

columns.name: copacker_toll_fee
columns.comment: Third-party manufacturing fee per unit when production is outsourced to a co-packer or toll manufacturer. Includes processing fee, packaging service, and contract manufacturing markup. Zero for internally manufactured SKUs.

columns.name: cost_estimate_number
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the costing run or cost estimate that generated this standard cost. Provides traceability to the source costing calculation and supports audit requirements.

columns.name: cost_status
columns.comment: Lifecycle status of the cost record: draft (under development), approved (validated but not yet active), active (currently in use for valuation), superseded (replaced by newer version), or archived (historical record).. Valid values are `draft|approved|active|superseded|archived`

columns.name: cost_variance_per_unit
columns.comment: Difference between current standard cost per unit and prior period cost per unit. Positive values indicate cost increases; negative values indicate cost reductions. Key metric for cost management and margin protection.

columns.name: cost_variance_percentage
columns.comment: Percentage change in standard cost per unit compared to prior period. Calculated as (cost_variance_per_unit / prior_period_cost_per_unit) * 100. Used for executive dashboards and cost escalation alerts.

columns.name: cost_version
columns.comment: Identifies the type of cost record: current standard (active production cost), prior year (historical comparison), budget (annual plan), forecast (updated projection), planned (future state), or actual (realized cost). Enables variance analysis and cost trend tracking.. Valid values are `current_standard|prior_year|budget|forecast|planned|actual`

columns.name: costing_lot_size
columns.comment: Standard production batch or lot size used as the basis for cost calculation. Affects fixed cost allocation per unit. Typically expressed in cases or production units.

columns.name: costing_method
columns.comment: Inventory valuation method applied to this SKU: standard (predetermined cost), average (moving average), First In First Out (FIFO), Last In First Out (LIFO), or weighted average. Determines how inventory is valued on the balance sheet.. Valid values are `standard|average|fifo|lifo|weighted_average`

columns.name: costing_run_date
columns.comment: The date on which the cost estimate was executed and this standard cost was calculated. Supports cost history tracking and regulatory compliance for cost substantiation.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: The date and time when this cost record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for cost data lineage and compliance.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the standard cost is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for multi-currency operations and consolidation.. Valid values are `^[A-Z]{3}$`

columns.name: direct_labor_cost
columns.comment: Direct labor cost per unit allocated from production operations including line operators, batch technicians, and quality inspectors. Based on standard labor hours and wage rates per manufacturing routing.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.comment: The date from which this standard cost becomes active and is used for valuation, pricing, and financial reporting. Supports cost roll-forward and period-over-period variance analysis.

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.comment: The date on which this standard cost record is superseded by a new cost version. Nullable for open-ended current standard costs.

columns.name: freight_in_cost
columns.comment: Inbound freight and logistics cost per unit to deliver raw materials and packaging to the production site. Includes transportation, handling, and customs duties. Part of landed cost calculation.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: The date and time when this cost record was last updated. Supports change tracking and cost variance investigation.

columns.name: manufacturing_overhead_cost
columns.comment: Allocated manufacturing overhead per unit including utilities, equipment depreciation, plant supervision, maintenance, quality assurance, and facility costs. Allocated based on cost center rates and activity drivers per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards.

columns.name: notes
columns.comment: Free-text field for cost accountants to document assumptions, adjustments, or special circumstances affecting this cost record (e.g., commodity hedging impact, one-time tooling amortization, co-packer contract changes).

columns.name: packaging_cost
columns.comment: Total cost of all packaging materials per unit including primary packaging (bottles, pouches, wrappers), secondary packaging (cartons, trays), and tertiary packaging (pallets, shrink wrap). Sourced from BOM packaging line items.

columns.name: price_control_indicator
columns.comment: SAP price control flag: S (standard price - cost remains fixed until manually updated) or V (moving average price - cost recalculated with each goods receipt). Determines inventory valuation behavior.. Valid values are `S|V`

columns.name: prior_period_cost_per_unit
columns.comment: Total standard cost per unit from the previous costing period. Enables period-over-period variance analysis and cost trend tracking for Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) reporting.

columns.name: raw_material_cost
columns.comment: Total cost of all raw materials and ingredients per unit as defined in the Bill of Materials (BOM). Includes commodity costs, agricultural inputs, and base formulation components. Key driver of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).

columns.name: total_standard_cost_per_case
columns.comment: Fully-loaded standard cost per case or shipping unit. Calculated as total_standard_cost_per_unit multiplied by units per case. Primary cost metric for trade promotion Return on Investment (ROI) analysis and Distribution Center (DC) valuation.

columns.name: total_standard_cost_per_unit
columns.comment: Fully-loaded standard cost per individual unit (e.g., per bottle, per pouch, per bar). Sum of raw material, packaging, direct labor, manufacturing overhead, co-packer fee, and freight-in costs. Used for unit-level profitability analysis and Recommended Selling Price (RSP) calculation.

columns.name: units_per_case
columns.comment: Number of individual consumer units (bottles, pouches, bars) contained in one case or shipping unit. Used to convert between unit-level and case-level cost metrics.

columns.name: valuation_class
columns.comment: SAP valuation class code that determines the General Ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) transactions are posted. Links product costing to financial accounting.

sales_core.order.name: order
sales_core.order.comment: Complete sales order document capturing all commercial sales transactions across retail, foodservice, and DTC channels, including both header-level and line-level detail in a single authoritative record. Header: order number, order date, requested delivery date, order type (standard, rush, blanket, standing), order status, channel, customer account reference, ship-to and bill-to locations, currency, payment terms, incoterms, total order value, EDI 850 reference, and ERP sales document number. Lines: line number, SKU/GTIN, ordered quantity, unit of measure (case, each, pallet), confirmed quantity, shipped quantity, open quantity, list price, net price after trade allowances, discount amount, line status, requested ship date, scheduled ship date, plant/DC assignment, batch number for FEFO compliance, and revenue recognition flag. SSOT for all outbound sales order commitments within the sales domain.

columns.name: order_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the order.

columns.name: account_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the customer who placed the order.

columns.name: employee_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Order approval workflow requires manager employee ID; needed for audit, compliance, and financial reporting.

columns.name: bill_to_location_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the location for billing purposes.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Orders are attributed to the marketing campaign that generated the demand; linking supports sales‑to‑marketing attribution and spend ROI analysis.

columns.name: center_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_center. Business justification: Order is fulfilled from a distribution center; linking enables direct relationship and removes distribution_center_code.

columns.name: plant_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Order originates from a manufacturing plant; linking provides traceability and eliminates redundant plant_code.

columns.name: price_list_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the price list applied to the order.

columns.name: price_zone_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Orders are priced according to regional price zones; required for regional pricing analysis, tax calculation, and regulatory reporting.

columns.name: promotion_event_id
columns.comment: Identifier of any promotion applied to the order.

columns.name: retailer_agreement_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to trade.retailer_agreement. Business justification: Required for Order‑Retailer Agreement compliance reporting; ties each order to the specific retailer agreement governing slotting fees and promotions.

columns.name: gl_account_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for General Ledger posting of order revenue; financial statements and tax reporting depend on linking each sales order to its revenue GL account.

columns.name: sales_contract_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the sales contract governing the order.

columns.name: sales_organization_id
columns.comment: FK to sales.sales_organization

columns.name: rep_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the sales representative responsible for the order.

columns.name: ship_to_location_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the location to which the order will be shipped.

columns.name: actual_delivery_date
columns.comment: Date the order was actually delivered.

columns.name: channel
columns.comment: Channel through which the order was placed.. Valid values are `retail|foodservice|direct_to_consumer|online|wholesale`

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when this order record was first captured.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Three-letter ISO currency code for the order amounts.

columns.name: edi_850_reference
columns.comment: Reference number of the EDI 850 purchase order transaction.

columns.name: erp_sales_doc_number
columns.comment: Sales document number generated in the ERP system.

columns.name: freight_terms
columns.comment: Terms governing freight cost responsibility.. Valid values are `prepaid|collect|third_party|FOB|CIF|DDP`

columns.name: incoterms
columns.comment: International commercial terms governing shipment responsibilities.

columns.name: is_backorder
columns.comment: True if any line items are on backorder.

columns.name: is_split_order
columns.comment: True if the order is split across multiple shipments.

columns.name: order_number
columns.comment: Business identifier assigned to the order by the sales system.

columns.name: order_source
columns.comment: Origin channel through which the order was entered.. Valid values are `EDI|Web|Phone|SalesRep|MobileApp|API`

columns.name: order_status
columns.comment: Current lifecycle status of the order.. Valid values are `draft|open|confirmed|fulfilled|cancelled|closed`

columns.name: order_type
columns.comment: Classification of the order based on processing rules.. Valid values are `standard|rush|blanket|standing|return|exchange`

columns.name: payment_terms
columns.comment: Payment terms agreed for the order (e.g., Net 30).

columns.name: placed_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the order was created in the source system.

columns.name: priority_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the order is marked as high priority.

columns.name: promised_delivery_date
columns.comment: Date promised by the company to deliver the order.

columns.name: requested_delivery_date
columns.comment: Date requested by the customer for delivery.

columns.name: revenue_recognition_flag
columns.comment: Indicates whether the order is eligible for revenue recognition at booking.

columns.name: sales_region
columns.comment: Geographic sales region associated with the order.

columns.name: shipping_method
columns.comment: Method used to transport the order to the customer.. Valid values are `ground|air|sea|rail|parcel|drone`

columns.name: total_discount_amount
columns.comment: Aggregate discount amount applied to the order.

columns.name: total_gross_amount
columns.comment: Sum of line item list prices before discounts and taxes.

columns.name: total_net_amount
columns.comment: Final amount after discounts and taxes.

columns.name: total_quantity
columns.comment: Sum of ordered quantities across all lines.

columns.name: total_tax_amount
columns.comment: Total tax calculated for the order.

columns.name: total_volume_cu_m
columns.comment: Aggregate volume of all items in the order (cubic meters).

columns.name: total_weight_kg
columns.comment: Aggregate weight of all items in the order (kilograms).

columns.name: trade_allowance_flag
columns.comment: Indicates if trade allowances (e.g., discounts, rebates) are applied.

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the most recent update to the order record.

sales_core.invoice.name: invoice
sales_core.invoice.comment: Complete commercial invoice document issued to customers upon shipment or delivery of goods, capturing both header-level and line-level detail in a single authoritative billing record for revenue recognition. Header: invoice number, invoice date, invoice type (standard, credit memo, debit memo, intercompany), customer account, billing address, currency, subtotal, trade discount, freight, tax, total amount, payment terms, EDI 810 reference, and SAP SD billing document number. Lines: line number, SKU/GTIN, billed quantity, unit of measure, list price, invoice unit price, line discount, line net amount, tax code, cost center, profit center, GL account code, and revenue category (gross sales, trade spend, net revenue). SSOT for accounts receivable origination within sales domain; finance domain owns downstream AR aging and collections.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.comment: System-generated unique identifier for the invoice record.

columns.name: account_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the customer billed on this invoice.

columns.name: employee_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Invoice approval must be signed off by an employee; essential for control‑testing and audit trails.

columns.name: bill_to_location_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the party responsible for payment.

columns.name: gl_account_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Invoice posting to the GL is mandatory for revenue recognition and audit trails; linking invoice to GL account enables accurate income statement reporting.

columns.name: original_invoice_id
columns.comment: Reference to the original invoice when this record is a credit or debit memo.

columns.name: price_list_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Required for invoicing audit: invoices must reference the price list used to calculate line amounts for compliance and margin reporting.

columns.name: production_order_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Cost of goods sold and compliance reporting need to associate each invoice with the production order that generated the sold goods.

columns.name: promotion_event_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to trade.promotion_event. Business justification: Needed for financial reconciliation of promotional spend; links each sales invoice to the promotion event that generated the sales.

columns.name: purchase_order_id
columns.comment: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Invoice‑PO reconciliation report requires linking each invoice to its purchase order for financial matching.

columns.name: ship_to_location_id
columns.comment: Identifier of the party receiving the goods.

columns.name: approval_status
columns.comment: Current approval state of the invoice.. Valid values are `pending|approved|rejected`

columns.name: approval_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the invoice was approved.

columns.name: billing_address_line1
columns.comment: First line of the billing address.

columns.name: billing_address_line2
columns.comment: Second line of the billing address (optional).

columns.name: billing_city
columns.comment: City component of the billing address.

columns.name: billing_country
columns.comment: Three-letter country code of the billing address.. Valid values are `USA|CAN|MEX|GBR|FRA|DEU`

columns.name: billing_postal_code
columns.comment: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address.. Valid values are `^[0-9A-Z-]{3,10}$`

columns.name: billing_state
columns.comment: State or province component of the billing address.

columns.name: contract_number
columns.comment: Identifier of the contract governing the transaction.

columns.name: cost_center
columns.comment: Organizational unit responsible for the cost of the invoice.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the system.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.comment: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the transaction currency.. Valid values are `USD|EUR|GBP|CAD|JPY|AUD`

columns.name: due_date
columns.comment: Date by which payment must be received.

columns.name: exchange_rate
columns.comment: Rate used to convert from transaction currency to reporting currency, if different.

columns.name: freight_amount
columns.comment: Charges for transportation and logistics associated with the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.comment: Timestamp when the invoice was issued to the customer.

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.comment: External business identifier assigned to the invoice (e.g., sequential number).

sales_core.pos_transaction.name: pos_transaction
sales_core.pos_transaction.comment: Point-of-sale scan data record capturing consumer purchase activity at the retail store level, sourced from retailer POS feeds, syndicated data providers (Nielsen/IRI/Circana/SPINS), and direct retailer data sharing programs (e.g., Walmart Luminate, Kroger 84.51°). sales_core.distribution_point.name: distribution_point
sales_core.distribution_point.comment: SSOT for SKU-level distribution presence, measurement, and periodic syndicated metric snapshots at retail and foodservice locations. Captures store/outlet ID, retailer banner, SKU/GTIN, distribution status (authorized, active, voided), ACV weighted distribution percentage, TDP (Total Distribution Points) contribution, numeric distribution percentage, velocity (units per point of distribution), in-stock status, void date, and periodic snapshot data by time period (weekly, 4-week, 13-week, 52-week) including snapshot date, market area, data source (Nielsen/IRI/Circana), and period-over-period change metrics. Enables distribution health monitoring, new item launch tracking, void management, TDP target attainment reporting, ACV trend analysis, and syndicated data reconciliation. Subsumes all periodic ACV/TDP snapshot reporting previously modeled separately.
